'''Eduardo Celmi Camavinga''' (born 10 November 2002) is a<!--Do NOT add nationality here, per WikiProject Football consensus--> professional [[Association football|footballer]] who plays as a [[midfielder|central midfielder]] and occasionally as a [[left-back]] for {{Spanish football updater|Real Madrid}} club [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]]. Born in Angola, he plays for the [[France national football team|France national team]].<ref>{{cite web |date=3 April 2023 |title=Casemiro, Rodri, Partey: Who is the world's best defensive midfielder? |url=https://www.givemesport.com/busquets-kante-casemiro-the-top-10-defensive-midfielders-have-been-ranked/ |access-date=11 July 2023 |website=GiveMeSport}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last1=Cheval |first1=Bastien |title=Eduardo Camavinga on his left-back role: "It's a different way of defending." |url=https://onefootball.com/id/berita/eduardo-camavinga-on-his-left-back-role-its-a-different-way-of-defending-37030263 |website=OneFootball |date=23 March 2023 |access-date=5 April 2023 |archive-date=5 April 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230405195253/https://onefootball.com/id/berita/eduardo-camavinga-on-his-left-back-role-its-a-different-way-of-defending-37030263 |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Didier Deschamps confirms Eduardo Camavinga as a left-back for France |website=Get French Football News |url=https://www.getfootballnewsfrance.com/2023/didier-deschamps-confirms-eduardo-camavinga-as-a-left-back-for-france/ |date=16 March 2023 |access-date=14 April 2023 |archive-date=14 April 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230414083247/https://www.getfootballnewsfrance.com/2023/didier-deschamps-confirms-eduardo-camavinga-as-a-left-back-for-france/ |url-status=live }}</ref> 

Camavinga began his career in [[Ligue 1]] with [[Stade Rennais FC|Rennes]], making his senior debut at the age of 16, and quickly established himself as a regular first-team player. In 2021, he signed for Real Madrid for a fee of €31 million, and over the following seasons, he helped the club win two [[La Liga]]–[[UEFA Champions League|Champions League]] doubles in [[2022 UEFA Champions League final|2022]] and [[2024 UEFA Champions League final|2024]].

Born in Angola, to Congolese refugees, Camavinga moved to France at a young age, eventually representing the country at the [[France national under-21 football team|under-21]] level. He made his first senior appearance for the France national team in 2020 at the age of 17, becoming the nation's youngest debutant in over a century. He was part of the French squad that finished runners-up at the [[2022 FIFA World Cup]].

==Early life==
Camavinga was born in a [[refugee camp]] in [[Cabinda (city)|Cabinda]], Angola in 2002. His parents, Celestino Camavinga<ref>{{Cite web |last1=Nieto|first1=Sébastien|last2=Quarez|first2=Benjamin|date=8 May 2024 |title=Coiffeur et Corcovado : entre Camavinga et Vinicius, le roman d'une belle amitié franco-brésilienne |url=https://www.leparisien.fr/sports/football/ligue-des-champions/coiffeur-et-corcovado-entre-camavinga-et-vinicius-le-roman-dune-belle-amitie-franco-bresilienne-08-05-2024-KNXI7SSXAVA6TBYS57DSCEM2RM.php |access-date=17 June 2024 |website=leparisien.fr |language=fr-FR}}</ref> and Sofia Simão, had fled the [[Second Congo War|civil war]] in [[Democratic Republic of the Congo|Congo]] before his birth in a refugee camp in [[Miconge]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=11 August 2023 |title=Eduardo Camavinga, des camps de réfugiés au Real Madrid – Jeune Afrique |url=https://www.jeuneafrique.com/1466546/culture/eduardo-camavinga-des-camps-de-refugies-au-real-madrid/ |access-date=12 August 2023 |website=JeuneAfrique.com |language=fr-FR}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.fifa.com/de/tournaments/mens/worldcup/qatar2022/news/camavinga-seiner-zeit-voraus |title=Camavinga: Seiner Zeit voraus |publisher=FIFA |language=de |date=9 September 2020 |access-date=29 November 2022 |archive-date=29 November 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221129133343/https://www.fifa.com/de/tournaments/mens/worldcup/qatar2022/news/camavinga-seiner-zeit-voraus |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://actu.fr/bretagne/fougeres_35115/football-eduardo-camavinga-pepite-fougeres_20433586.html|title=VIDÉO. Football : Eduardo Camavinga, la pépite de Fougères qui vient de signer pro au Stade Rennais|website=actu.fr|date=2 January 2019 |access-date=23 July 2019|archive-date=8 July 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200708060939/https://actu.fr/bretagne/fougeres_35115/football-eduardo-camavinga-pepite-fougeres_20433586.html|url-status=live}}</ref> He has five siblings. His family moved to France when he was two.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2023/feb/20/eduardo-camavinga-real-madrid-champions-league|title=Eduardo Camavinga: 'People think Madrid are dead, but Madrid are never, never dead'|date=20 February 2023|work=Guardian|accessdate=21 February 2023|archive-date=20 February 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230220231420/https://www.theguardian.com/football/2023/feb/20/eduardo-camavinga-real-madrid-champions-league|url-status=live}}</ref> They eventually settled in [[Fougères]], where he grew up. He did [[judo]] for a time before giving it up to focus solely on football. In 2013, the Camavingas' house was burnt down, destroying most of the family's property. Camavinga stated that this was a source of motivation that pushed him to pursue a career in football and help his family.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/soccer/french-ligue-1/story/3950530/eduardo-camavinga-is-only-16-but-his-form-for-rennes-has-top-european-scouts-circling|title=Eduardo Camavinga is only 16 but his form for Rennes has top European scouts circling|publisher=ESPN|date=25 September 2019|access-date=4 April 2020|archive-date=1 September 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210901101247/https://www.espn.com/soccer/french-ligue-1/story/3950530/eduardo-camavinga-is-only-16-but-his-form-for-rennes-has-top-european-scouts-circling|url-status=live}}</ref>

On 7 July 2020, he obtained the ''[[Baccalauréat]]'' ES (Economic and Social) [[Baccalauréat#Passing and honours|without mention]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Rennes : Eduardo Camavinga a eu son bac|url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Football/Actualites/Rennes-eduardo-camavinga-a-eu-son-bac/1150514|access-date=29 August 2020|website=L'Équipe|language=fr|archive-date=17 November 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201117022617/https://www.lequipe.fr/Football/Actualites/Rennes-eduardo-camavinga-a-eu-son-bac/1150514|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Rennes : Eduardo Camavinga nouveau bachelier|url=https://sport.francetvinfo.fr/football/ligue-1/rennes-eduardo-camavinga-nouveau-bachelier|access-date=29 August 2020|website=Francetvsport|language=fr|archive-date=15 November 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201115021232/https://sport.francetvinfo.fr/football/ligue-1/rennes-eduardo-camavinga-nouveau-bachelier|url-status=live}}</ref>

==Club career==
===Rennes===
[[File:Eduardo Camavinga, in Rennes, after his victory in Coupe de France, April 28th, 2019.png|thumb|upright|Camavinga in 2019]]

Camavinga joined [[Stade Rennais F.C.|Rennes]]' youth system when he was eleven. He signed his first professional contract on 14 December 2018, at the age of 16 years and one month, becoming the youngest ever professional for the club at that time.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.staderennais.com/premier-contrat-professionnel-pour-eduardo-camavinga|title=Premier contract Professionnel pour Eduardo Camavinga|language=fr|date=14 December 2018|website=staderennais.com|publisher=Stade Rennais F.C.|access-date=4 April 2020|archive-date=19 December 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191219064841/https://www.staderennais.com/premier-contrat-professionnel-pour-eduardo-camavinga|url-status=live}}</ref> He made his professional debut for Rennes in a 3–3 [[Ligue 1]] tie with [[Angers SCO|Angers]] on 6 April 2019,<ref>{{cite web|url=https://int.soccerway.com/matches/2019/04/06/france/ligue-1/angers-sporting-club-de-louest/stade-rennais-fc/2792517/|title=Angers SCO vs. Rennes – 6 April 2019|publisher=Soccerway|date=6 April 2019|access-date=4 April 2020|archive-date=18 November 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201118013951/https://int.soccerway.com/matches/2019/04/06/france/ligue-1/angers-sporting-club-de-louest/stade-rennais-fc/2792517/|url-status=live}}</ref> becoming the youngest player to ever play for Rennes' first team,<ref>{{cite web|url=https://bleacherreport.com/articles/2861180-rennes-sensation-eduardo-camavinga-is-a-new-kind-of-16-year-old-footballer|title=Rennes Sensation Eduardo Camavinga Is a New Kind of 16-Year-Old Footballer|website=bleacherreport.com|publisher=Bleacher Report|date=7 November 2019|access-date=4 April 2020|archive-date=22 January 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210122132046/https://bleacherreport.com/articles/2861180-rennes-sensation-eduardo-camavinga-is-a-new-kind-of-16-year-old-footballer|url-status=live}}</ref> at 16 years and six months old.

On 18 August 2019, Camavinga recorded an assist and was awarded the man of the match award in a 2–1 win against [[Paris Saint-Germain F.C.|Paris Saint-Germain]].<ref>{{Cite web|date=19 August 2019|title=Eduardo Camavinga: Angola youngster reacts after helping Rennes stun PSG|url=https://www.goal.com/en-us/news/eduardo-camavinga-angola-youngster-reacts-after-helping/g7jidorlz4kk1vqi77uk9r801|access-date=18 August 2020|website=Goal (website)|archive-date=23 November 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201123225633/https://www.goal.com/en-us/news/eduardo-camavinga-angola-youngster-reacts-after-helping/g7jidorlz4kk1vqi77uk9r801|url-status=live}}</ref> Hence, he became the youngest player to make an assist in Ligue 1, aged 16 years and 281 days.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/world-records/587424-youngest-player-to-make-an-assist-in-ligue-1 |title=Youngest player to make an assist in Ligue 1 |publisher=Guinness World Records }}</ref> He then won the [[UNFP Player of the Month]] award that month, to be the youngest player to achieve this feat.<ref name="auto1">{{cite web |url=https://www.goal.com/en-kw/lists/17-fun-facts-about-eduardo-camavinga/blta4a327b53e7f543e#cs1d079b032e6ef6a3 |title=17 fun facts about Eduardo Camavinga |publisher=Goal.com |date=24 April 2023 }}</ref> He scored his first goal for Rennes in a 1–0 win against [[Olympique Lyonnais|Lyon]] on 15 December 2019, in the 89th minute of the game.<ref>{{Cite web|date=15 December 2019|title=Rennes Beat Lyon|url=https://bleacherreport.com/game/olympique-lyonnais-vs-stade-rennais-fc-2019-12-14|website=Bleacher Report|access-date=19 August 2020|archive-date=31 August 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210831031035/https://bleacherreport.com/game/olympique-lyonnais-vs-stade-rennais-fc-2019-12-14|url-status=dead}}</ref>

In the [[2020–21 UEFA Champions League]], he featured in four matches for Rennes against [[FC Krasnodar|Krasnodar]], [[Chelsea F.C.|Chelsea]] and [[Sevilla FC|Sevilla]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/2531232/2021/04/25/eduardo-camavinga-youve-heard-the-name-heres-why-europes-top-clubs-want-him/ |title=Eduardo Camavinga: You've heard the name, here's why Europe's top clubs want him |website=The Athletic |date=25 April 2021 |access-date=30 August 2021 |archive-date=30 August 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210830234516/https://theathletic.com/2531232/2021/04/25/eduardo-camavinga-youve-heard-the-name-heres-why-europes-top-clubs-want-him/ |url-status=live }}</ref>

===Real Madrid===
On 31 August 2021, [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]] announced the signing of Camavinga until 30 June 2027.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Official Announcement: Camavinga {{!}} Real Madrid CF |url=https://www.realmadrid.com/en/news/2021/08/31/official-announcement-camavinga |access-date=22 June 2023 |website=Real Madrid C.F. – Web Oficial}}</ref> He made his debut in a 5–2 win over [[RC Celta de Vigo|Celta Vigo]] on 12 September, in which he scored a goal shortly after coming off the bench.<ref>{{Cite web |date=12 September 2021 |title=Real Madrid teenage star Camavinga scores six minutes into debut {{!}} Goal.com |url=https://www.goal.com/en-in/news/real-madrid-teenage-star-camavinga-scores-six-minutes-into-debut/b7u5e7cs01551q4oj2l8bysiw |access-date=22 June 2023 |website=www.goal.com |language=}}</ref> Three days later, he made his Champions League debut for Real Madrid, coming on as a substitute for [[Luka Modrić]] in the 80th minute and assisting [[Rodrygo]] for the winner against [[Inter Milan]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Real Madrid: Eduardo Camavinga's assist for the winner against Inter shows wisdom beyond his years |url=https://therealchamps.com/2021/09/16/real-madrid-eduardo-camavinga-assist-inter/ |access-date=16 September 2021 |website=therealchamps.com |date=16 September 2021 |archive-date=17 September 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210917180251/https://therealchamps.com/2021/09/16/real-madrid-eduardo-camavinga-assist-inter/ |url-status=live }}</ref>

Camavinga made a substitute appearance in the 85th minute of the [[2022 UEFA Champions League final]] on 28 May, helping Real Madrid win 1–0 over [[Liverpool F.C.|Liverpool]] to earn the [[2021–22 UEFA Champions League]] title with his team.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://uk.sports.yahoo.com/news/camavinga-labels-real-madrids-champions-144516550.html|title=Camavinga labels Real Madrid's Champions League triumph a 'dream come true'|website=uk.sports.yahoo.com|access-date=2 June 2022|archive-date=2 June 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220602180244/https://uk.sports.yahoo.com/news/camavinga-labels-real-madrids-champions-144516550.html|url-status=live}}</ref> On 9 May 2023, he provided an assist to [[Vinícius Júnior]] to take the lead in a 1–1 draw against [[Manchester City F.C.|Manchester City]] in the [[2022–23 UEFA Champions League|Champions League]] semi-final first leg at the [[Santiago Bernabéu Stadium|Santiago Bernabéu]], to be the youngest in the competition's semi-finals to do so, aged 20 years and 180 days.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://onefootball.com/en/news/real-madrids-eduardo-camavinga-after-1-1-draw-against-manchester-city-its-not-necessarily-a-bad-result-its-50-50-37435420 |title=Real Madrid's Eduardo Camavinga after 1–1 draw against Manchester City: "It's not necessarily a bad result… It's 50–50." |publisher=OneFootball |date=9 May 2023 }}</ref>

On 7 November 2023, Real Madrid announced the extension of Camavinga's contract, which is to remain effective until 30 June 2029.<ref>{{Cite news |date=7 November 2023 |title=Camavinga extends Real Madrid contract until 2029  |work=BBC Sport |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/67346132 |access-date=7 November 2023}}</ref>

He missed the first official match of the 2024–25 season, the [[2024 UEFA Super Cup]], after injuring his left knee in training on the eve of the match and was expected to be out for several weeks with an internal sprain to the knee.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Real Madrid : Inquiétude pour Camavinga, forfait pour la Supercoupe d'Europe |url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Football/Actualites/Inquietude-pour-camavinga-forfait-pour-la-supercoupe-d-europe/1501234 |access-date=31 August 2024 |website=L'Équipe |language=fr}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Real Madrid : Eduardo Camavinga éloigné des terrains plusieurs semaines après sa blessure au genou |url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Football/Actualites/Eduardo-camavinga-eloigne-des-terrains-plusieurs-semaines-apres-sa-blessure-au-genou/1501306 |access-date=31 August 2024 |website=L'Équipe |language=fr}}</ref> On 2 October 2024, Camavinga returned to action against [[LOSC Lille|Lille]] in the [[2024–25 UEFA Champions League]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/live/crejngyw5n5t |title=Lille 1–0 Real Madrid |publisher=BBC Sport |date=2 October 2024 }}</ref>

Camavinga endured a difficult season, marked by a decline in performance and reduced playing time. Less influential in Real Madrid's midfield, he was gradually relegated to a secondary role by [[Carlo Ancelotti]]. Occasionally lining up at left-back due to absences in that area, he was unable to rediscover his best form. His season came to a premature end on 23 April 2025, when he suffered a total rupture of his left adductor tendon during a match against [[Getafe CF|Getafe]]. The injury would rule him out for several months, forcing him to miss the [[2025 Copa del Rey final|Copa del Rey final]], the [[UEFA Nations League Finals]], and the [[FIFA Club World Cup]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Camavinga, une blessure qui met fin à une saison décevante avec le Real Madrid |url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Football/Actualites/Camavinga-une-blessure-qui-met-fin-a-une-saison-decevante-avec-le-real-madrid/1556670 |access-date=25 April 2025 |website=L'Équipe |language=fr}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=24 April 2025 |title=Foot : Eduardo Camavinga victime d'une rupture complète à l'adducteur et très incertain pour la fin de saison |url=https://www.francetvinfo.fr/sports/foot/real-madrid/foot-eduardo-camavinga-victime-d-une-rupture-complete-a-l-adducteur-et-tres-incertain-pour-la-fin-de-saison_7208394.html |access-date=25 April 2025 |website=Franceinfo |language=fr-FR}}</ref>

On 30 September 2025, he scored his first [[UEFA Champions League]] goal in a 5–0 away win over [[FC Kairat|Kairat]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.espn.com/soccer/report/_/gameId/757671 |title=Kylian Mbappé bags hat trick as Real Madrid thrash Kairat Almaty |publisher=ESPN |date=30 September 2025 }}</ref>

==International career==
On 31 October 2019, Camavinga obtained [[French nationality law|French nationality]], benefiting from the collective effect connected to the [[naturalization]] of his father.<ref>[https://www.legifrance.gouv.fr/jorf/jo/2019/11/03/0256 Journal Officiel de la République française (JORF), 3 novembre 2019], Texte 69.</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Football/Actualites/Rennes-eduardo-camavinga-a-ete-naturalise-francais/1076897|title=Rennes : Eduardo Camavinga a été naturalisé français|language=fr|website=[[L'Équipe]]|date=5 November 2019|access-date=5 November 2019|archive-date=29 October 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201029204712/https://www.lequipe.fr/Football/Actualites/Rennes-eduardo-camavinga-a-ete-naturalise-francais/1076897|url-status=live}}</ref> Until then, Camavinga had been a national of the Republic of the Congo.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Eduardo CAMAVINGA – |url=https://www.unfp.org/joueur/eduardo-camavinga-22734/ |access-date=8 November 2023 |website=www.unfp.org}}</ref> Six days later, he was selected to represent [[France national under-21 football team|France's under-21 team]] for games against Georgia and Switzerland, after [[Matteo Guendouzi]] was called up to the senior team.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Football/Actualites/Eduardo-camavinga-rennes-officiellement-convoque-en-equipe-de-france-espoirs/1079298|title=Eduardo Camavinga (Rennes) officiellement convoqué en équipe de France Espoirs|language=fr|website=[[L'Équipe]]|date=11 November 2019|access-date=11 November 2019|archive-date=16 October 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201016224146/https://www.lequipe.fr/Football/Actualites/Eduardo-camavinga-rennes-officiellement-convoque-en-equipe-de-france-espoirs/1079298|url-status=live}}</ref>

On 27 August 2020, Camavinga was called up to play on [[France national football team|France's senior team]] after [[Paul Pogba]] was sidelined by a positive [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] test. He became, in the process, the youngest player to be called up to the French senior team since [[René Gérard (footballer)|René Gérard]] in 1932, who was only 17 years, nine months and 17 days old.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.francefootball.fr/news/Eduardo-camavinga-devient-le-plus-jeune-joueur-appele-en-equipe-de-france-depuis-l-apres-guerre/1165253|title=Eduardo Camavinga devient le plus jeune joueur appelé en équipe de France depuis l'après-guerre...|language=fr|website=[[France Football]]|date=27 August 2020|access-date=28 August 2020|archive-date=20 April 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210420204817/https://www.francefootball.fr/news/Eduardo-camavinga-devient-le-plus-jeune-joueur-appele-en-equipe-de-france-depuis-l-apres-guerre/1165253|url-status=live}}</ref> On 8 September, he debuted in a 4–2 win against [[Croatia national football team|Croatia]] in the [[2020–21 UEFA Nations League A#Group 3|UEFA Nations League]], replacing [[N'Golo Kanté]] midway through the second half.<ref>{{Cite news|title=France 4–2 Croatia|language=en-GB|work=BBC Sport|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/54002970|access-date=8 September 2020|archive-date=9 September 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200909171609/https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/54002970|url-status=live}}</ref> In doing so he became the youngest player to play for the France national team, following [[Maurice Gastiger]] in 1914 at 17 years, nine months, and 29 days old.<ref>{{Cite news|title=Eduardo Camavinga plus jeune international français depuis 1945|language=fr|work=[[L'Équipe]]|url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Football/Actualites/Eduardo-camavinga-plus-jeune-international-francais-depuis-1945/1169600|access-date=9 September 2020|archive-date=25 October 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201025200353/https://www.lequipe.fr/Football/Actualites/Eduardo-camavinga-plus-jeune-international-francais-depuis-1945/1169600|url-status=live}}</ref>

On 7 October 2020, Camavinga made his first start for France in a 7–1 win against [[Ukraine national football team|Ukraine]] where he scored his first international goal, opening the scoring with an overhead kick. This made him the youngest goalscorer for France since [[Maurice Gastiger]] in 1914.<ref>{{Cite news|title=Eduardo Camavinga plus jeune buteur des Bleus depuis 1914|language=fr|work=[[L'Équipe]]|url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Football/Actualites/Eduardo-camavinga-plus-jeune-buteur-des-bleus-depuis-1914/1181112|access-date=8 October 2020|archive-date=8 October 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201008054203/https://www.lequipe.fr/Football/Actualites/Eduardo-camavinga-plus-jeune-buteur-des-bleus-depuis-1914/1181112|url-status=live}}</ref>

On 25 June 2021, Camavinga was named in [[Sylvain Ripoll]]'s 18-man [[France national football team|France squad]] for the [[2020 Summer Olympics|Summer Olympics in 2021]].<ref>{{Cite news|date=25 June 2021|title=THE LIST FOR THE TOKYO GAMES|language=fr|work=[[French Football Federation]]|url=https://www.fff.fr/article/3089-la-liste-pour-les-jeux-de-tokyo.html|access-date=25 June 2021|archive-date=29 June 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210629181432/https://www.fff.fr/article/3089-la-liste-pour-les-jeux-de-tokyo.html|url-status=live}}</ref> However, he was later removed from the squad after his club, Rennes, objected.<ref>{{cite news |last1=De Cosemo |first1=Harry |title=Tokyo 2020: Olympic men's football players to watch |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/olympics/57833180 |access-date=22 July 2021 |work=BBC Sport |date=21 July 2021 |archive-date=26 July 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210726025545/https://www.bbc.com/sport/olympics/57833180 |url-status=live }}</ref>

Camavinga played twice at the [[2022 FIFA World Cup]], in which reigning champions France finished as runners-up in Qatar. He played as a left-back in the final group game, a 1–0 loss to [[Tunisia national football team|Tunisia]] in which manager [[Didier Deschamps]] rested his regular players ahead of the knockout stage.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Johnson |first1=Jonathan |title=FIFA World Cup 2022: France lose to Tunisia to wrap up group as Deschamps tests Camavinga at left back |url=https://www.cbssports.com/soccer/news/fifa-world-cup-2022-france-lose-to-tunisia-to-wrap-up-group-as-deschamps-tests-camavinga-at-left-back/ |access-date=17 June 2024 |work=CBS Sports |date=30 November 2022}}</ref> In the [[2022 FIFA World Cup final|final]], he came on after 71 minutes in place of [[Théo Hernandez]] as the French were losing 2–0 to [[Argentina national football team|Argentina]]; the game ended 2–2 after 90 minutes and 3–3 after extra time, as France lost on penalties.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Menzies |first1=John |title=Eduardo Camavinga's World Cup final performance will give Carlo Ancelotti food for thought |url=https://www.football-espana.net/2022/12/21/eduardo-camavingas-world-cup-final-performance-will-give-carlo-ancelotti-food-for-thought |access-date=17 June 2024 |publisher=Football España |date=21 December 2022}}</ref>
